name: opencode-plugin-goal-plan
description: Goal/Plan modes for OpenCode — /goal, /plan, /task, /review workflow commands

opencode.name: Goal Plan
opencode.description: Structured goal/plan/task workflow — /goal to set objective, /plan to decompose, /task to execute, /review to validate

commands.name: goal:set
commands.description: Set the current goal with acceptance criteria

commands.name: plan:create
commands.description: Create a plan from the current goal (auto-decompose or manual)

commands.name: plan:show
commands.description: Show current plan with task status

commands.name: task:next
commands.description: Get next actionable task from plan

commands.name: review:gate
commands.description: Run review gate checks against acceptance criteria
